name: apple-notes
description: Read and safely manage native Apple Notes from Codex or ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: List Notes accounts and folders, search and inspect existing notes, and safely create, append, rename, move, replace, or delete one native Apple Note. Exact IDs protect mutations; shared and password-protected notes stay read-only.
defaultPrompt: Find my notes about the launch.
Show the note I edited most recently.
Create a note called Project brief.
Append these decisions to my project brief.
